gaps.sentence: He was ___ (APPOINT) at the election result.

gaps.explanation: 'Championship victory' — the title/contest, not the person.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (DEEP) of the lake is unknown.
gaps.explanation: 'Depth' — noun from deep (spelling change: deep → depth).

gaps.sentence: The factory will ___ (EMPLOY) fifty more workers next year.
gaps.explanation: The bare verb follows 'will': will employ.

gaps.sentence: The thief was ___ (ARREST) at the border.
The delays have made the project far more ___ (COST) than planned.
gaps.explanation: 'Far more costly' — the comparative adjective is needed after 'more'.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (ARRIVE) of the delegation was delayed by the storm.
